doc: The function called WITHOUT lacunarity and top: the Python defaults 2.03 and 0.95 (texture.py calls octave_ladder(fine_frequency, fmax) with exactly these; generate.py passes top). 16 rows (low_frequency, max_frequency): the production maps (low 48 at widths 256..16384 with 2 texels per wavelength, low 3 at 256 and 4096 with 4), hi == low (10 against 10 / 0.95: both sides of the comparison give (10, 1) because ln(1 + 2e-16) / ln(2.03) floors to 0), hi just above low, hi below low, low 0.01 .. 1e4 (20 octaves). No row sits within 1e-6 of a floor boundary of the log ratio (checked at build time). Both the start frequency (hi / lacunarity^(n - 1), rtol 1e-9) and n move with either default: five mutated defaults (lacunarity 2.0, 2.029, 2.05, top 0.9, 0.951) each change at least 8 of the 16 rows (checked at build time). start: float64 closed form, rtol 1e-9; n: exact.
